name: Sister Kutsumi
source: The vice principal of St. Emilia Girls Academy as well as the leader of the prostitution circle. She gives direct orders to the protagonist [url=/c88067]Tomoya[/url]. Despite being a nun she isn't all that devoted, doesn't really believe in God and is always eager to have sex.
